# LiveDataLink

> Live and regularly refreshed public data for AI agents: 291 MCP tools across 59 domains, one Streamable HTTP endpoint, and one bearer API key.

This repository is a distribution wrapper. The hosted server is authoritative; do not treat a static copy of a tool list in this repository as current.

## Connect

- Endpoint: `https://livedatalink.ai/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
- Live inventory: call `tools/list`
- Server card: `https://livedatalink.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- Health and catalog counts: `https://livedatalink.ai/health`
- Catalog and source/freshness notes: `https://livedatalink.ai/tools`, `https://livedatalink.ai/status`, and `https://livedatalink.ai/data`

## Access and pricing

- Anonymous evaluation: 25 lifetime data-tool calls per network, at up to 10 requests/minute. `search_available_datasets`, `list_tool_groups`, and `get_free_api_key` remain free.
- Free API key: 1,000 queries/month, 5 requests/minute, no credit card.
- Starter: $10/month, 5,000 queries/month, 30 requests/minute.
- Pro: $49/month, 50,000 queries/month, 120 requests/minute.
- Every plan includes every tool. Monthly allowances are hard limits; there are no automatic overage charges.

## Accuracy contract

Some domains query an upstream source live and some use scheduled snapshots. Inspect `https://livedatalink.ai/status` before relying on a freshness-sensitive result. Tool schemas, availability, and counts change over time; `tools/list` and the server card above are the canonical machine-readable sources.

For the human installation guide, see `README.md`. For the repository's listing-maintenance process and a record of third-party directory discrepancies, see `LISTING_FRESHNESS.md`.
